description: Code-ready high-scale reconstruction for Fig. S4 scaling trends.
paper_parameter_notes: The printed vector-text axis labels in raw/paper.txt:1385 and 1400 freeze the even grid M=4,6,...,22 without reading source-figure pixels as numerical inputs.
The figure text explicitly cites 2000-instance simulations for the entropy-gap study; this config freezes that published ensemble count and leaves execution to a sufficiently large compute host.
M=22 is an explicit acceptance boundary and must remain in every paper-scale run.
